title: Title and Paragraph
summary: Write a simple course introduction page using titles and paragraphs.
tasks: Add an h1 in main with the text "My first webpage".
Add a p below the title with the text "I am learning web design."
hint: Write both h1 and p in main. End h1 by writing p immediately, leaving the period at the end of the paragraph.
goal: Use h1 to mark the page topic, and then use a paragraph to add an introduction.

example.code:
Wednesday maintenance workshop

Meet in the maker room at two o'clock in the afternoon.
example.note: The main title of the announcement introduces the event name, and the following paragraphs give the gathering time and location.
